messages:
marie-sec: Heads-up: prod SCIM errors started after last night's KMS rotate. Some service accounts lost external IDs and RBAC lookups return 404s. Audit shows kms:Decrypt failures for new alias. Anyone on idp/infra?

ajay-idp: saw alerts, joining. Which alias was rotated?

marie-sec: alias/redwood-prod-2026-03-22. Logs show mixed success/fail for same alias. Example:
```
2026-03-22T21:59:12Z scim-provisioner ERROR svc=provisioner-2 kms:Decrypt failed alias/redwood-prod-2026 error=InvalidCiphertextException
2026-03-22T21:59:12Z scim-provisioner WARN svc=provisioner-2 payload_id=svcacct-901 http_status=500
```

kevin-sre: could be rewrap partial visibility or replication lag. Any recent RBAC changes for the provisioner role?

marie-sec: no RBAC changes. Rewrap job ran 21:48 UTC. Old alias alias/redwood-prod still exists pointing at previous key.

ajay-idp: known race: some instances may have cached DEKs wrapped by old key. If metadata update isn't atomic with re-encrypt, you get mixed decrypts. Which hosts are failing?

marie-sec: failures mostly on provisioner-2 and provisioner-7 in us-east-1. Others fine.

kevin-sre: mitigation: restart affected replicas so they reload envelope metadata/DEKs. Pause any SCIM writers in canary.

marie-sec: restarting provisioner-2 now.

sre-oncall: restarting provisioner-7 and holding canary batch 3.

deploy-bot: deploy 1718102019 by kevin-sre to provisioner-2 restarted (success)

ajay-idp: after restart, check audit log for "kms:Decrypt succeeded" and ensure envelope keyVersion == redwood-prod-2026. If mismatch, prepare rewrap backfill.

marie-sec: provisioner-2 now shows decrypt success; provisioner-7 had 3 failures then recovered. No 500s in last 6m.

kevin-sre: action items: 1) schedule controlled backfill rewrap for envelopes still referencing older key; 2) add replication confirmation step in rewrap orchestration; 3) add alert for mixed-key decrypts.

ajay-idp: will author backfill dry-run script that checks envelope metadata and re-encrypts if keyVersion!=redwood-prod-2026. Will run dry-run first and post results. Will add replication-check to orchestrator.

marie-sec: also need a short-lived fallback: treat missing extID as retryable (not deny) during key operations, some downstreams treat missing extID as deny.

kevin-sre: will open PR to change provisioner error handling to return 429/retry for extID-not-found during maintenance windows.

sre-oncall: updating runbook with these steps and annotating incident. Postmortem stub created.

marie-sec: assigning followups: ajay -> backfill dry-run + replication guard; kevin -> PR for retry behavior; sre-oncall -> runbook update + postmortem. Monitoring for lingering 500s.

ajay-idp: ETA dry-run later today, will report.

kevin-sre: PR when ready.

marie-sec: TL;DR root cause likely non-atomic rewrap visibility across replicas. Short-term: restart replicas + pause canary. Medium-term: replication checkpoint + backfill. Thanks all :thumbsup:
